prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach object, take and lift it. If heavy, activate mechanism. Move and activate task. Else, scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ActivateLiftingMechanism    /> <Action ID = ActivateTaskMechanism    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ScanSurroundings    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <SubTree ID = MoveToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = TakeObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO ActivateLiftingMechanism
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO ActivateTaskMechanism
	END
